description: This source file defines the internal class CachedVersionSelectorManager, which manages cached version selection logic for grain interfaces, including cache retrieval, reset, and computation of suitable silos based on versions and compatibility considerations.

classes.name: CachedVersionSelectorManager
classes.description: Manages cached data related to grain interface version selection, including retrieving suitable silos and cache management.

methods.name: GetSuitableSilos
methods.description: Retrieves cached suitable silos for a given grain type, interface, and version, recomputing if cache is stale or missing.

methods.name: ResetCache
methods.description: Clears the internal cache of suitable silos.

methods.name: GetSuitableSilosImpl
methods.description: Computes the suitable silos for a given key involving grain type, interface, and version by leveraging version selection and compatibility logic.
